🧠 NBack

N-Back is a cognitive training task scientifically shown to improve working memory. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Watch the sequence of positions on the grid.
  2. Press 'Match' when the current position is the same as N steps ago.
  3. In dual mode, also listen for audio matches.
  4. N increases as you pass levels — higher N means more demanding memory.
  5. Accuracy matters more than speed — false positives are costly.
